rows.grounds: compound of govarddhana and giri; locative expressing location
past participle describing the figure from prior context
compound of rāsa, rasa, and utsuka expressing longing

items.question: What location and eager longing characterize the deity's presence on Govardhana hill?
premises: The deity is situated on the Govardhana hill.
The Govardhana hill is described as delightful.
The deity is eager for the delight of the rāsa.
items.inference: The verse presents the deity as present on the delightful Govardhana hill with eager anticipation for the rāsa.
items.plain_english: Situated on the delightful Govardhana hill, eager for the delight of the rāsa.
